taxonomic_note: Current project treatment follows the modern Gonolobus suberosus var. granulatus concept. Legacy Matelea gonocarpos records are not transferred automatically because that name has been applied to differing concepts.
look_here_first: Look for a vigorous twining vine with large opposite cordate leaves, relatively large uniform olive-green star-shaped flowers, and a long smooth follicle with strong longitudinal angles.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Later manual reconciliation using Krings' specimen revision documents var. granulatus in Comal, Kendall, and Travis counties.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Do not transfer eastern var. suberosus records or unreconciled Matelea gonocarpos records into this variety.

best_field_traits: flowers roughly 16–25 mm across in regional treatment
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Var. granulatus differs from var. suberosus in flower-color/appendage characters; unlike Matelea reticulata, it lacks the strongly reticulate corolla and muricate pod.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Uniform olive-green flowers plus yellow dorsal anther appendages and a smooth sharply angled follicle are the strongest learner cues; avoid relying on vine habit alone.
